prerequisite: O06 with independently verified evidence; chapter availability does not satisfy this prerequisite
scope: Task comments added to the invited-user collaborative task API. This is an equivalent controlled alternative to the capstone label exercise, not a relaxation of its delivery gates.

content.server_owned_fields: cannot be forged or moved by request payload

permissions.active_project_member: read/list/create; edit or redact own visible comments
permissions.project_owner: member rights plus redact any comment in that project; cannot rewrite another author
permissions.former_member: no read/list/create/edit/redact, even with an old unexpired credential or old authorship
permissions.outsider: no access; cannot infer private object content through changed parent IDs
permissions.historical_author: removing membership does not remove the author attribution of old comments

redaction.normal_reads: tombstone metadata only; original text must not leak through list/detail/history/export/logs
redaction.internal_retention: student chooses and explains retention/deletion plus backup implications; no promise of retroactive erasure from old backups

concurrency.editing: a request identifies its base revision; two competing edits from that revision cannot both silently overwrite; stale request is rejected
concurrency.redact_versus_edit: committed redaction cannot be reversed by a delayed edit; report actual order and visible final state
concurrency.membership_removal: requests started after removal commits must be denied; define and test the policy for already in-flight operations

repeated_create.same_payload: within the window, concurrent/repeated requests represent one logical comment and return the same identity when still authorized
repeated_create.changed_payload: same scoped request identity with different text is a conflict; original remains unchanged
repeated_create.authorization: replays must re-check current permission and must not leak an earlier response after membership revocation
repeated_create.after_window: student documents and tests a bounded expiry policy; exactly-once delivery forever is not required
repeated_create.failed_or_uncertain_response: no partial accepted comment; retry can resolve the same logical outcome without a duplicate

listing.stable_order: deterministic tie-breaker for equal timestamps; unchanged-dataset pagination has no skips/duplicates
listing.concurrent_change_policy: document and test, do not silently promise snapshot consistency

compatibility.existing_rows: preserve old users/projects/members/tasks, identifiers and allowed operations after migration; old tasks start with zero comments
compatibility.task_deletion: task with any comment, including a tombstone, cannot be physically deleted in this extension; document the conflict without changing deletion of uncommented tasks
compatibility.parent_project_deletion: must not silently erase comments through project deletion; choose a documented policy consistent with the task-deletion rule
compatibility.release_rollback: state which old application revision can run against which schema; preserve accepted new comments or explicitly freeze safely; no blind destructive downgrade

operations.restore: actually restore into an owned isolated target and verify relationships, permissions, revisions, tombstones and replay behavior; a backup file alone is insufficient
operations.pilot: 2..5 explicitly invited testers after O06 and safety gates, with non-sensitive data, budget/account/target approval and one traceable feedback iteration
operations.no_environment: record blocked, do not claim public deployment or waive O06
operations.evidence_redaction: no credentials, bearer tokens, private keys, raw connection passwords or sensitive comment bodies in shared evidence
